:::{#exm-set-predicate-notation}
#### One indicator in both notations

Let $A = [0, \infty)$, the nonnegative real numbers.
The indicator of $A$ is $\indic{A}(x)$ in set notation,
and $\indicp{x \in A}$ or $\indicp{x \ge 0}$ in predicate notation
(@def-set-predicate-notation).
At $x = 3.5$, all three equal $1$;
at $x = -2.1$, all three equal $0$.

:::
